name: Trim Stain Application — Template
intent: Stain coat by application method + between-coat sand to knock down raised grain. Repeats per ctx.stain_coats via scenario.dynamic_coats. Extended by per-substrate MOD_APPLY_<substrate>_STAIN modules.
doctrine: Stain side defaults height:false uniformly across all 14 trim substrates (matches MOD_TEMPLATE_TRIM_CLEANUP_STAIN). Sand fires after every coat so the last stain coat is sanded before sealer goes over.
